This file guides Claude Code for TD Studios’ luxury Next.js 15 website, synced with v0.app and deployed on Vercel.

## Stack/Structure
Next.js 15.5.4 App Router, React ^18, strict TypeScript ^5, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind 3.4.17/PostCSS, Radix/shadcn New York RSC, pnpm 10.15.1, Geist, Lucide, Vercel Analytics, Vitest/jsdom, Playwright, OpenAI ChatKit, Resend, `jose` JWT.

`app/` routes; `api/` APIs; `contact/`, `chatkit/session/`, `intake/`; service routes `work/`, `web/`, `dev/`, `social/`, `design/`, `process/`, `faq/`, `book/`, `legal/`, `support/`, `resources/`; protected `clients/[client]/`, `[client]/signin/`; `components/`, `lib/`, `public/`, `styles/`, `tests/`.

## Environment
Create `.env.local` in the project root; use `.env.local.example`:
`RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE` (e.g., `CLIENT_THEBODYBOUTIQUE_PASSCODE`).

## Commands
```bash
pnpm dev
pnpm serve
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm ci:verify
pnpm report:types
pnpm scan:secrets
pnpm scan:secrets:staged
pnpm test
pnpm test:watch
pnpm test:jest
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --ui
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts
pnpm lh:routes
```

Vitest uses `vitest.config.ts`, `tests/setup.ts`, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, `@/`, globals, JSX/esbuild, and `passWithNoTests: false`; excludes `**/mobile-layout.spec.ts` and `**/playwright/**`. Playwright covers mobile layout/accessibility behavior. ESLint errors and TypeScript build errors are ignored during builds for deployment compatibility.

## Configuration/Design
Strict mode, ES2017, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`, isolated modules, App Router plugin; `@/*` maps to root. Images: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; AVIF/WebP. `www.tdstudiosny.com` → `tdstudiosny.com` permanent 301 redirect.

Luxury mobile-first dark/light design: black `oklch(0.145 0 0)`, white text, OKLCH neutral tokens, 0.625rem radius, Geist, Lucide, Tailwind spacing, semantic accessible HTML/ARIA/keyboard navigation. Glass cards: Neutral-900 70%, blur, borders. `layout.tsx` includes StickyHeader, Footer, analytics, iOS Safari fixes.

Track page views, clicks/location, form outcomes, downloads, bookings, scroll/time, CTA position, conversions. A/B tests support definitions, variants, allocation, enable/disable, analytics.

## APIs/Auth
Contact uses Resend; ChatKit creates/continues OpenAI sessions and returns token/configuration; Intake stores qualified Supabase leads and returns lead ID/status. JWT tokens are signed/verified with `jose` and `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters required). Each client uses `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`; `/[client]/signin` authenticates; `/clients/[client]` requires valid JWT.

## Workflow/Security
Auto-sync is v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. Major changes should use v0.app; consider sync implications for manual edits. Project: https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7. Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky hooks install automatically via postinstall. Pre-commit scans staged files. Pre-push enf

## Workflow/Security

Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky hooks install automatically via postinstall. Pre-commit scans staged files. Pre-push enforces feature branches and scans secrets:

```bash
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }
```

Secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`. All changes to main must go through PRs.

## Routes
`/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. Nav: WORK · WEB · DEV · SOCIAL · DESIGN · PROCESS · RESOURCES · FAQ · CONTACT. Footer: Support · Legal · Book. All pages include canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`.

See `ROUTES.md` and `docs/architecture-map.json`.
